name: X-Madrid Open 2023
information:
La competición se celebrará dentro del evento "III Edición del Orgullo Friki", que tiene lugar del 25 al 28 de mayo.
The competition will be a part of the "III Edition of Geek Pride" event, which will take place from May 25th to the 28th.
